name: Epitech Barcelona
overview:
Location


Epitech welcomes you to its Barcelone campus for a course focusing on IoT.


The campus is located in the 22@ technological neighborhood, next to the city center and very close to the beach (5min), the subway (5min), a bicycle station (1min), and features everything you need to learn and have fun during your international year.


Carrer Joan Miró, 21

08005 Barcelona

Tel: 0034 93 797 88 14

Email: barcelona@epitech.eu

Closest metro: Vila Olimpica (line 4)


Campus Ecosystem


EPITECH Barcelona is linked to many associations and platforms that support tech startups and educational initiatives in the city and abroad:

  • Barcelona Tech City
  • Barcelona Activa
  • 22@ Network
  • Mobile World Capital
  • Barcelona Digital Talent
  • French Tech Barcelona


Professional Experience


Since it was founded in 2017, our Barcelona campus has been forming tailor-made partnerships with companies.

This approach helps us place innovation at the heart of different economic sectors.

Most of the Tek4 students who want to work in Barcelona can make it for an internship in world-class companies and startups.


About the city


Barcelona is the capital city of the region of Catalonia in Spain and the country’s second most populated city after Madrid, with a population of 1.6 million. Its urban area extends beyond the administrative city limits with a population of around 4.7 million people, being the seventh most populous urban area in the European Union. It is the largest city on the Mediterranean Sea. Founded as a Roman city in the Middle Age and besieged several times during its history, Barcelona has a rich cultural heritage and is today an important cultural center and a major tourist destination.


The redevelopment of the city for the Olympic Games of 1992 created a new Barcelona open to the sea. The old docks were torn down, and tons of sand was brought to create miles of sandy beaches which now stretch from Barceloneta to the Port Olimpic. The city is probably nowadays the most important and vibrant city of the Mediterranean.


City of free, open culture, Barcelona is a modern, cosmopolitan and dynamic city that is proud of its diversity, figuring among the top European cities in quality of life rankings. It offers a wide range of cultural and tourist attractions, with nine of its buildings recognized as Human Heritage Sites by UNESCO. It is also one of the top 15 safest cities in the world and one of the ten most appealing cities in the world for launching a digital business.
administrative:
1. For internships in a Spanish company


Please note: Spanish agreement to be signed once on site.

For those who wish to do an internship / work during the year, you can do it every Monday and Tuesday. It is an excellent opportunity that we encourage. During these two days there will be no scheduled courses so as not to prejudice those who decide to work. But on Wednesdays, Thursdays and Fridays you will have face-to-face courses on campus. You will have to attend, and will not be able to use work / internship as an excuse in case of absence.

Remember to inform EPITECH BARCELONA by email of the steps you take with companies, especially if you have already found an internship.

For information, for workers who are not resident for tax purposes (and you cannot be a tax resident if you spend less than 183 days in the territory during the calendar year - not academic - which will often be your case) the rate tax is high: 19% or 24%. Consider talking to companies about it so you don't have any surprises about your final net compensation.


2. Application for NIE (Numero de Identididad de Extranjero)


No visa is necessary for students who are nationals of a member state of the European Union or for students resident in one of the member states of the European Union and who hold a residence permit in that country.


Any foreigner wishing to reside in Spain for more than 3 months must request a NIE once arrived in Spain and within 30 days of entering the country.


Remember to start taking steps in April to obtain your NIE. You will need it to start working legally, even on an internship, and the steps to obtain it can take a long time being that it is difficult to obtain an appointment because of the saturation of the police stations in Barcelona.

You can start the process from France by making an appointment on the internet (try a few weeks in advance to obtain an appointment for the month of September).

One possibility is also to try without an appointment outside Barcelona, arriving and queuing from the earliest hour in the police stations of one of the following cities: Bellaterra, Sant Andreu de la Barca or Badalona.


3.Insurance and Health


For students wishing to do an internship, it is imperative to take out a complementary medical insurance covering accidents / hospitalization / repatriation AND civil liability in Spain before leaving. International insurance must cover the entire period of your studies in the country. Insurance costs are the responsibility of each student.

To take out international insurance, the market is quite open. Please click here for more information.

It is also recommended to apply for the European "Améli" insurance card on ameli.fr. The card is nominative and individual. This card certifies your rights to Health Insurance and allows you to pay for your care in Europe.


To obtain your card, log into your Ameli account at least two weeks before your departure (more information here).

  • You have no documents to provide.
  • This card is valid for one year. If, upon receipt of your card, your card indicates cover until December of the calendar year, please apply again in October / November of the fourth year so that it covers the rest of the school year (up to to June).
  • At the doctor, the pharmacist, and in public service hospitals, present your card or your provisional certificate.
  • Thanks to your European health insurance card, your medical expenses are covered under the same conditions as for the insured in the country that welcomes you.


It will also be imperative to obtain a Spanish social security number (ask us for precise explanations on site).


Note: It is advisable to register on the French register established outside France and to report to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs via the Ariane platform: https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html.


4.CROUS scholarship (French students)


If you're going to Epitech Barcelona for your Tech4, you can have access to the CROUS scholarship.


5.Prepare your arrival


To find out more about daily life in Barcelona, visit the following website: BCN student.


For more information about current events on our campus and to get a sense of what it's like to study at EPITECH Barcelona, feel free to check out our Instagram page or Tiktok account.


To find out more on travel advice issued by the Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs on Spain, click here.


6.Campus life


The BDE organizes various activities for students throughout the year.


Team-building activities are a great tool to help students learn to work together, listen carefully, communicate clearly and think creatively. They also give our students the chance to get to know each other, build trust as a community and, best of all, have fun!


In order to do so and engage with the local ecosystem, at EPITECH Barcelona we organize plenty of fun events throughout the year:

BBQs on campus, Epitech Fun Days, Presentations and Spanish classes, Attendance to international fairs and events, etc.

Academic Calendar


September - May


Department and Courses


The fourth year abroad is a chance to hone the focus of your future career aspirations by specializing in a specific domain. Additionally, an IT expert must now be a professional capable of analysing the missions of his company. An IT expert is now at the heart of strategic development projects in his or her company and must be able to connect with and understand the professions that surround him.


In light of this, the programs at Epitech’s European campuses plunge you into the techniques you need to learn for a specific domain so that you can develop the skills necessary to transition seamlessly into the sector of your preference. Because IT is now interlaced with every aspect of society, Epitech chooses to form you as dual experts – IT of course, but also business, communication, and strategy.


The Barcelona Tek4 program mainly focuses on Innovation & Entrepreneurship in the IoT domain. The main goal of this course is to provide the Innovation and Entrepreneurship key points and main tools to our students, with the objective to be applied in a real innovation project during the year (also known as the Capstone Project).


Examples of modules

  • AIOT Fundamentals, prototyping and UX/UI
  • Introduction to hardware
  • Cloud and Smartcities and business developement
  • Deaplearning, Machine learning and digital Economy
  • Metaverse and autonomous car
  • LLM and 5G


Course format and Workload


The Capstone Project, the “pièce de la resistance” of the Campus Euro program, incorporates all the technical skills you learn with your projects over the course of the year with these “soft” skills to lend a completely new dimension to your year. The Capstone Project is the determining element in receiving your certificate.


Throughout the year, via a series of hands-on projects, you will develop just as many technical competencies related to your specialization as you will skills that intersect with the fields surrounding IT. Meanwhile, other technical courses will be developed on both semesters to enrich this innovation proposal, most of them related to the IoT domain, thanks to the relevant position of Barcelona’s ecosystem on this context. In addition to that, all the technical and transversal courses will be developed by a great team of experts and professionals in these areas of expertise.

The program is therefore centred on developing two strengths at once – technical and entrepreneurial, leading to the deliverance of an additional IoT certificate which will incontestably attest to your expertise.

Financial overview (4th Year EPITECH)


  • You must pay the tuition fees for the 4th year of EPITECH, as well as the re-registration fees and related fees.
  • EPITECH covers the application fees and part of the tuition fees.
  • Other costs at your expense include: travel, accommodation on site, insurance, and everyday expenses (books, food, transport, etc.).


Other Expenses


  • Roundtrip airfare: Paris-Barcelona flight (90 min.) Around 150 €
  • Bus:
  • FlixBus: Barcelona-Paris (2 p.m.): € 35 each way
  • Eurolines: Barcelona-Paris (2 p.m.): € 60 per trip
  • Insurance: European insurance card "Améli" (free) Apply for it at least 1 month in advance / about 300€ for an additional insurance depending on the coverage if you do an internship
